name: Eutychus
role: Young man who fell from a window as Paul preached
whenBasis: Paul's last journey to Jerusalem, a few years after he left Ephesus.
summary: A young man at Troas who sat in the window as Paul talked until midnight on the first day of the week. Sinking into a deep sleep as Paul talked on and on, he fell from the third storey and was picked up dead. Paul went down, threw himself on him and embraced him: “Do not be alarmed!… He is still alive!” Paul went back up, broke bread, talked until daybreak and left; they took the boy home alive and were greatly relieved.
body: There are many lamps in the upstairs room where they are gathered. His name means fortunate.
